title: ReplyIntent
description: Output contract for prompts/05-reply-classification.md. unsubscribe always wins over every other signal; unclear or confidence < 0.7 routes to the human queue.

summary.description: One sentence for the operator queue.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when intent=out_of_office and a date is stated; null otherwise.

referral_name.description: Referred person's name when intent=referral; null otherwise.

referral_contact.description: Referred person's email/phone if present; null otherwise.

objection_type.description: Set when intent=objection, for objection-typed nurture routing; null otherwise.
